title: Research
text:

title: Working Projects
text:
Active research projects and analytical work in progress. These represent ongoing empirical investigations, data pipelines, and analytical tools being developed as part of my dissertation research.



Interruption Management in Continuous Pharmaceutical Manufacturing


[span class=“card-tag”]{Pharma Operations}[/span] [span class=“card-tag”]{Time Series}[/span] [span class=“card-tag”]{Causal Inference}[/span] [span class=“card-tag”]{R}[/span]

Empirical analysis of exogenous interruptions in a CDC-50 continuous direct compression line using ~300M data points from a 120-hour production run. Models the cascading effects of upstream feeding interruptions on downstream productivity and tablet quality metrics using OLS and logistic regression with date fixed effects.
Status: Analysis complete — paper in drafting stage
Key tools: R · tidyverse · lmtest · sandwich · gt · Quarto · Shiny
GitHub Repo




NIL Collective Effects on Play-Calling Behavior in College Football


[span class=“card-tag”]{Sports Economics}[/span] [span class=“card-tag”]{Panel Data}[/span] [span class=“card-tag”]{Two-Way FE}[/span] [span class=“card-tag”]{R}[/span]

Panel study spanning 2014–2025 examining how NIL collective presence causally affects offensive and defensive play-calling behavior across FBS programs. Uses cfbfastR play-by-play data (~2.4M rows) with a two-way fixed effects design and 2021 NIL cutoff.
Status: Data construction complete — analysis ongoing
Key tools: R · cfbfastR · fixest · Python (ESPN API scraping)

GitHub repo coming soon





Discrete Event Simulation Digital Twin — CDC-50 Process


[span class=“card-tag”]{Simulation}[/span] [span class=“card-tag”]{DES}[/span] [span class=“card-tag”]{R}[/span] [span class=“card-tag”]{Three.js}[/span]

Physics-based discrete event simulation of the CDC-50 continuous manufacturing line parameterized from empirical interruption distributions (Weibull/exponential MTTBF/MTTR). Targets throughput simulation, starvation/blocking cascade analysis, and OEE estimation. Companion to the interruption management paper.
Status: Planning stage — building on simmer package

In development




All projects are conducted in compliance with data sharing agreements. Raw data is not publicly available. Code, methodology, and summary outputs are shared via GitHub.
